title: Pointwise henselian SNC residual chart
statement: Let p be a positive prime and k a field of characteristic p. Let Y be a regular separated finite-type k-scheme [def-weil-regular-scheme] and D a strict normal crossings boundary [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary], with finitely many distinct integral regular labelled components C_i whose intersections are regular of the expected codimension. Fix a set I of component labels. In the open Y_I obtained by deleting components outside I, let S be the reduced intersection of the components in I. Use the residual-chart and parameter-tower data of [def-sfb-snc-residual-chart-data]. Then for every point z of the reduced stratum there is one residual chart Q and a point of Spec(B_Q/J_Q) mapping to z. This is pointwise chart existence, with no atlas, covering-family assertion or comparison/refinement assertion.

proof.text: For a point of the reduced stratum choose a labelled affine stratum chart containing its image. Restrict its open immersion to the complement of the unselected components; base change identifies its residual quotient with the residual stratum pullback.

proof.text: At every finite stage use ind-etale regular-stage ascent. The parameter subtuple at a prime above the marked ideal extends to a full parameter system; henselianity puts the marked ideal inside every maximal ideal. Apply the filtered henselian parameter-root theorem to obtain domains and nonzero products at all finite and full levels.

proof.text: Apply the punctured-cover tower theorem to supply its maps and colimits. Compatible-unit-root splitting gives primitive compatible roots with unit differences. All required spectra are nonempty connected affine schemes by the domain conclusions. Empty tuples give the zero ideal, identity henselization, and identity root algebras.

theorem exists_sncResidualChart_at
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (y : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType y] [QuasiCompact y] [IsSeparated y]
    (hY : IsRegularScheme Y) (D : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (hD : IsStrictNormalCrossingsBoundary D)
    (a : ℕ) (C : Fin a → Y.IdealSheafData)
    (hC : Function.Injective (fun i ↦ (C i).support) ∧
      (∀ i, IsIntegral (C i).subscheme ∧ IsRegularScheme (C i).subscheme) ∧
      D.support = ⨆ i, (C i).support ∧
      ∀ s : Finset (Fin a), ∀ z : (⨆ i ∈ s, C i).subscheme,
        IsRegularScheme (⨆ i ∈ s, C i).subscheme ∧
        ringKrullDim (Y.presheaf.stalk ((⨆ i ∈ s, C i).subschemeι z)) =
          ringKrullDim ((⨆ i ∈ s, C i).subscheme.presheaf.stalk z) + (s.card : ℕ))
    (I : Finset (Fin a)) (z : (sncStratumIdeal C I).subscheme) :
    ∃ (Q : SNCResidualChart p C I)
      (w : Spec (.of (Q.B ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range Q.t)))),
      (Q.residualIso.hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _) w = z
